title: Apache PySpark using Databricks
overview: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Apache PySpark and Databricks, enabling participants to process large-scale data efficiently. It covers core PySpark concepts, DataFrames, RDDs, SQL, machine learning, and real-world implementations in Databricks, a cloud-based collaborative data analytics platform. Participants will gain hands-on experience in using Databricks for big data processing, analytics, and AI-driven workloads.
audience: Big Data Analysts and AI Engineers
Software Developers working with large datasets
Cloud Engineers focusing on distributed computing
Business Analysts and BI Professionals working with Spark
Anyone looking to integrate PySpark with Databricks
methodology: Hands-on Labs – Practical exercises using Databricks Notebooks
Real-World Use Cases – Implementing PySpark in business scenarios
Live Demonstrations – Step-by-step walkthroughs on PySpark & Databricks
Code-Along Sessions – Writing, executing, and debugging PySpark scripts
Group Discussions & Q&A – Engaging discussions on Spark optimizations
Project-Based Learning – Final capstone project using Databricks & PySpark
competencies: Big Data Processing with Apache PySpark
Data Manipulation and Transformation using PySpark DataFrames
Writing and Optimizing Spark SQL Queries
Machine Learning with MLlib on Spark
Performance Optimization and Debugging in Spark Jobs
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Apache PySpark’s architecture, components, and ecosystem
Write PySpark scripts for data analysis and transformation
Perform structured data processing with DataFrames and SQL
Use Databricks for distributed computing and collaborative analytics
Optimize PySpark jobs for better performance and scalability
Implement machine learning workflows using Spark MLlib
Handle real-world big data challenges with PySpark and Databricks

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Apache PySpark and Databricks

items.text: Overview of Big Data, Apache Spark, and PySpark
What is Databricks and how does it enhance Spark?
Setting up a Databricks Workspace (Cloud & On-Prem options)
PySpark vs. Pandas vs. SQL – When to use what?
Resilient Distributed Datasets (RDDs) vs. DataFrames
PySpark Transformations and Actions
Lazy Evaluation and Execution Plans
Data Serialization and Storage Formats (Parquet, Avro, JSON)

outline.title: Module 3: Data Processing with PySpark DataFrames

items.text: Creating DataFrames from structured and semi-structured data
Performing Data Cleaning and Data Wrangling
Using PySpark UDFs (User-Defined Functions) for custom operations
Data Aggregation, Joins, and Window Functions

outline.title: Module 4: Spark SQL and Query Optimization

items.text: Writing SQL queries in PySpark
Using Catalyst Optimizer for query execution planning
Partitioning and Caching for Performance
Handling Large-Scale Datasets Efficiently
Working with Databricks Notebooks
Cluster Management and Autoscaling in Databricks
Databricks Jobs & Task Scheduling
Integrating Databricks with Cloud Storage (Azure, AWS, GCP)

outline.title: Module 6: Machine Learning with PySpark MLlib

items.text: Introduction to Spark MLlib for Scalable Machine Learning
Feature Engineering and Data Preprocessing in PySpark
Training and Evaluating ML Models in Databricks
Running ML Pipelines in a Distributed Environment

outline.title: Module 7: Performance Optimization and Debugging in PySpark

items.text: Understanding Job Execution Plans & Spark UI
Optimizing Shuffling, Caching, and Broadcast Joins
Troubleshooting Memory Issues and Out-of-Memory Errors
Best Practices for Optimized Cluster Resource Allocation

outline.title: Module 8: Real-World Use Cases & Industry Applications

items.text: ETL Pipelines using PySpark in Databricks
Customer Segmentation using Spark MLlib
Log Analytics and Fraud Detection with PySpark
Real-Time Data Processing with Structured Streaming
